go_rule_text: PRE-STATED SCREEN GO RULE, REVISION 7 (T2b-register; supersedes revisions 1-6, stated before any output exists; seed by seed; point estimates on the fresh dev screen bank, decided EXACTLY on integer counts as rationals (no floating-point rounding: a difference or share equal to a bar meets a '>=' bar and does not meet a '<' bar); 95% cluster-bootstrap CIs reported, not gating; every condition component decided within one bootstrap SE of its bar is flagged in the report). TRAINING: the surface-diversity build 'sd' only (decision point 1 fired: PREREG-3 TRIGGER): the same 750 rows, each prompt rendered with a seeded rule-text paraphrase (0-3), field names (variants 0-3 per field) and JSON key orders drawn from a TRAIN subset of permutations per object type (top level, state, event); paraphrase 4, field-name variant 4 and the HELD-OUT key orders (per object type the fully reversed canonical order plus 2 fixed seeded permutations where they exist; the 2-key top level has only its reversed order, so it trains in the canonical order alone) never occur in training; targets keep the literal cmp -> calc -> after order. Outcome = exact 'after' state (the decision parser reads only 'after'; a malformed trace/filler answer is wrong). Two renderings of the same rows, paired by row: IN-SURFACE = Titan's verbatim one-step frame; HELD-OUT SURFACE (HS) = paraphrase 4 + field-name variant 4 + a held-out key order per object type, rotating over the held-out orders by row, on the primary strata and on the three identification strata. PRIMARY outcomes are out of range (joint amendment 5): 'conditional' = cond_oor_val + cond_oor_thr + cond_far pooled (branch-balanced pairs; cond_far = in-range values and thresholds with |other - threshold| 16..96, beyond every training row's 0..15); 'cond_oor_val' = the boundary pairs alone (other = threshold: ok false; other = threshold + 1: ok true); 'mix' = mix_oor. IDENTIFICATION strata (G1 only; none is pooled into 'conditional'): 'cond_sametens' = 50 branch-balanced minimal pairs with tens(other) == tens(threshold), so the branch is decided by the units digit, |other - threshold| in 2..9 (2..7 realized: both members of a pair lie in one decade), |value| 12..40 (out of range), in-range registers and thresholds, neither branch wraps; it separates the comparison from tens-digit shortcuts that are exact on every primary conditional row (e.g. 'add iff tens(other) > tens(threshold) or other == threshold + 1' scores 1/2 on it); 'cond_oor_edge' (revision 5) = 20 branch-balanced minimal quadruples at the boundary of the env's strict 'other > threshold': other - threshold = -1 and 0 (ok false) and +1 and +2 (ok true), |value| 12..40 (out of range), in-range registers and thresholds, neither branch wraps, 10 quadruples moving the threshold and 10 the other register; with cond_oor_val it gives G1 rows at other = threshold - 1, threshold and threshold + 1, so every off-by-one variant of the comparison (one that differs from it only at other = threshold - 1, threshold or threshold + 1, e.g. '>=', '> threshold + 1', '>= threshold - 1', 'or other == threshold - 1') is contradicted on at least 1/4 of its rows; 'cond_adv' (revision 6) = 100 rows, 50 ok true and 50 ok false, drawn by seeded rejection sampling over valid conditional rows (other 0..96, threshold -40..136, |value| 12..40, neither branch wraps) to fixed quotas of 15 design types: 13 signature classes of the extended shortcut family H (sets of (other, threshold) cells on which exactly the same members of H are wrong), one of them split by digit lengths, covering sign-crossing cells, cross-length cells (1 vs 2, 2 vs 1, 1 vs 3 and 2 vs 3 digits), cross-decade cells whose units comparison disagrees with the tens comparison and cells at other - threshold = -3, -2, +3, +4; H (scripts/t2br_shortcuts.py, DESIGN.md section 15; 3,519 predicates) = the enumerated digit and off-by-one family with its modifiers at other = threshold - 1, threshold and threshold + 1 (3,483 predicates, the branch-blind constants included) + lexicographic string comparison with and without sign handling, digit-sum, units-only and tens-only comparisons with sign- and length-aware variants, magnitude-only |other| > |threshold| and the isolated single-distance exceptions at |other - threshold| = 2..4; on cond_adv every member of H that differs from the comparison somewhere on that domain and passes revision 5's G1 against a plain arm at 0 is wrong on at least 33 rows, except the isolated distance exceptions, of which those at other - threshold = -3, -2, +3 and +4 are wrong on exactly 21 (the operator's target, every member of H wrong on at least 40 rows, is infeasible on any 100-row branch-balanced stratum: five members of H have pairwise-disjoint error sets). PREDICATE ACCURACY (trace side; arithmetic-independent): the share of a stratum's rows whose trace answer the strict joint parser accepts, whose cmp is an object with exactly the keys x, thr, ok in that literal order, and whose ok is a JSON boolean equal to the env's predicate (other > threshold) for that row; x and thr are not scored; a malformed trace or a wrong key order counts as wrong. FILLER (amendment 4b): the fill length is a per-kind constant: the smallest run of ' .' units such that the filler target is at least as long (Titan tokens) as the LONGEST trace target of that kind over train + dev (one-step rows and the chains' gold steps), whatever its 'after' (swap 7, add 17, mix 17, conditional 29 units); every filler target of a kind is identical up to 'after', so its length carries no information about the answer. VALIDITY: format_ok = the strict joint parser accepts the answer; the trace (filler) side is valid iff its in-surface format_ok >= 0.95 on each primary. DECISION POINT 3 (checked first): if trace - filler < 0.10 on BOTH in-surface primaries, STOP: 'trace ~ filler, not supervision of the intermediates (an answer-free filler of constant length per action kind, amendment 4b, does as well: the gain is attributable to extra decode positions or the answer format)', with the sub-label 'trace format failed' if the trace side is not valid, else 'filler control invalid' if the filler side is not valid, else 'neither format helped' if filler - plain < 0.10 on both in-surface primaries. Otherwise GO iff ALL of: (G1) trace - plain >= +0.25 on conditional, on cond_oor_val alone, on cond_oor_edge alone AND on cond_sametens alone, AND the trace side's predicate accuracy >= 0.80 on cond_oor_edge alone, on cond_sametens alone AND on cond_adv alone (cond_adv has no trace - plain clause), each both in-surface and on the held-out surface (the predicate clauses have no plain-arm term, so a plain arm that is weak on the out-of-range arithmetic cannot let through a member of H that they catch; G1 excludes the members of the enumerated family H that differ from the comparison, except the isolated exception 'other > threshold or other == threshold - 4', which passes every G1 part, as documented by the enumeration over H against three plain baselines (DRYRUN.json shortcut_enumeration); it does NOT exclude heuristics outside H, and natural ones pass every G1 part (LIMITS)); (G2) trace - plain >= +0.30 on mix, both in-surface and on the held-out surface; (G3) filler below trace: trace - filler >= +0.10 on EACH in-surface primary; (G4) controls: trace ON - OFF >= -0.05 on swap and on add_nowrap (untouched skills; in-surface); (G5) in-distribution non-inferiority: trace - plain >= -0.05 on conditional_in (branch-balanced mean over cond_xm1, cond_x0, cond_xp1, cond_mid) and on mix_in (in-surface); and the filler side is valid. If G1-G5 all hold but the filler side is not valid: INCONCLUSIVE: filler control invalid. Otherwise NO-GO, naming every failed condition and its failed parts. Reported, not gating: the held-out-surface results of the OFF and filler sides; the surface audit (held-out minus in-surface, paired by row, every side and held-out-surface stratum); the filler residual covariate (constant filler tokens minus that row's trace tokens) with the filler side's accuracy split at its median; the shortcut-agreement analysis (the trace side's cmp.ok against the env's predicate and against every member of H over all conditional rows of the dev bank, in each rendering: 'SHORTCUT_CONSISTENT' if a member of H that differs from the predicate on those rows agrees with the trace's cmp.ok at least as well as the predicate does; it never changes the verdict; it is quoted with every statement of the verdict, so with any GO, and whenever it is set the OVERALL headline carries it beside the verdict, with a pointer to the LIMITS); per-factor held-out renderings (paraphrase only, names only, key order only) are omitted by choice (a GPU-budget choice, not a capacity limit). LIMITS, quoted with every statement of the verdict (t2br_common.ALWAYS_QUOTED_LIMITS; DESIGN.md section 14): (1) G1 excludes the members of the enumerated family H that differ from the comparison EXCEPT the isolated exception 'other > threshold or other == threshold - 4', which passes every G1 part (on any 100-row branch-balanced stratum one of the exceptions at other - threshold = -4, -3, -2 passes the 0.80 bar); (2) heuristics OUTSIDE H are NOT excluded, and natural ones pass every G1 part (the revision-6 independent check, confirmed by verdict() on exact counts): isolated single-distance exceptions at |other - threshold| >= 5 (H has them only at 2..4) and flipped distance bands (e.g. 5..9); three-digit-threshold slips (the hundreds digit dropped, only the first two digits read, a threshold above 96 reduced modulo 97, string comparison only against three-digit thresholds, always adding when the threshold is above 96); a register of 0 never counted above a negative threshold; the sign of a threshold at or below -10 dropped; a circular comparison ((other - threshold) mod 97 in 1..48); string comparison only for one-digit thresholds or one-digit registers; guessing on the far rows (|other - threshold| > 15) by string comparison or a prior (other > 48, threshold < 48), and, against a plain arm well below chance on the pooled conditional (the dry run's coin-flip plain at 5/12, or a weak plain arm), also by always adding, always subtracting or the units digit; any rule that departs from the comparison only on cells that no G1 stratum contains (e.g. in-range cross-decade cells at |other - threshold| 5..15, decided by the units digit or with the branch flipped); the report-only shortcut-agreement flag compares the members of H only, so its absence does not rule these out; (3) cond_adv catches its targets only at narrow margins: the exceptions at other - threshold = -3, -2, +3, +4 are wrong on exactly 21 of its 100 rows (79/100, one row below the bar) and the signed string, magnitude, and sign+length-aware digit-sum and units comparisons on exactly 33 (67/100), so a trace that follows a caught member on only part of its rows can pass (following it everywhere except on any 1 of those 21 rows, or any 13 of those 33, passes G1), and a trace that departs from the comparison on at most 1/5 of each predicate-gated stratum's rows passes the predicate clauses; (4) per-factor held-out renderings are omitted; (5) a GO is a seed-0 screen result. The screen is seed 0; the roadmap's confirmation requires the same rule in all 3 seeds before a sealed R bank is built.
